english.title: Incite procession participant to breach a condition - Public Order Act 1986

english.legislation: Contrary to section 12(6) and (10) of the Public Order Act 1986.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: This offence applies from the 28th June 2022 due to changes made by the Police, Crime, Sentencing and Courts Act 2022 increasing the penalty. For the offence applying before this date, see H2437.

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 51 weeks imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months Note
In relation to an offence committed before section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 comes into force, the reference to 51 weeks imprisonment in relation to summary offences is to be read as a reference to 6 months imprisonment.
